When you use Orelia, you're cool with the terms in this Privacy Policy. Your privacy matters a lot to us, and we're all about keeping your info safe and sound. We want you to feel secure while enjoying our platform, so you can use our services without worrying about your personal data.

We only gather the personal data necessary to provide and enhance our services effectively. This includes information you provide during sign-up, such as your name and email, along with any optional details you choose to share. We ensure your data is managed lawfully and transparently at all times, prioritizing your comfort and peace of mind. Your trust is essential to us, and we take it very seriously, ensuring all practices are in your best interest.

We implement robust security measures to safeguard your personal information from unauthorized access or alterations. Your payment details are encrypted and stored in compliance with industry standards to ensure your financial safety and security at all times. This allows you to use our services worry-free, and we are dedicated to providing a seamless and secure payment experience for all our users.

You can manage your cookie preferences directly in your browser settings for optimal control over your online experience and to tailor it to your needs. Unauthorized use or distribution of our content is strictly prohibited and may result in legal action, ensuring fairness and respect for all creators involved. We will also cease sending you promotional messages to respect your preferences and ensure your comfort. This allows you to have full control over your account, and your satisfaction is our priority as we respect your choices.

This Privacy Policy follows the laws of the State of Florida. If any issues come up, they'll be sorted out in Florida's courts, making sure everyone gets treated fairly and our agreements stay solid. We're all about protecting your rights and being open and fair in everything we do with you.

By using Orelia, you’re saying you’ve read and agree to this Privacy Policy. If you have any questions or need help, just reach out to our support team—they're always here to assist you! Understanding the sources of anxiety is the first step toward managing it. Anxiety often stems from a combination of genetic predispositions, environmental stressors, and learned behaviors. Identifying these factors can provide valuable insights into your unique experience. By exploring the interplay between biology, psychology, and life events, you can develop a more comprehensive understanding of your anxiety.

Having a straightforward plan can really help ease anxiety. Quick tip: Give deep breathing or the 5-4-3-2-1 method a shot. Daily habits: Get moving, eat good food, and make sure you get enough sleep. For the long haul: Work on being mindful and shifting your thought patterns. Pro tip: Put together your own anxiety toolkit!

Consistent self-care is crucial for managing anxiety.Practice Daily Mindfulness – Even a few minutes of meditation can significantly reduce stress. Engage in Joyful Activities – Make time for hobbies and activities that bring you pleasure and relaxation. Limit Exposure to Triggers – Reduce your consumption of negative news and social media to minimize anxiety triggers.Example: Instead of scrolling through stressful news, try listening to calming music or spending time in nature.
